title: RAG-Based Document Q&A
description: A full-stack RAG system with semantic search over text embeddings, supporting Google Drive OAuth and persistent chat history. Built with React, FastAPI, pgvector, and Gemini API.

title: Worklog AI
description: Productivity tracking platform featuring LLM-powered summaries, JWT authentication, and automated CI/CD pipelines. Developed with Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and OpenAI APIs.

title: ATS Resume Validator
description: A 3-tier architecture tool that parses resumes to score keyword alignment and identify skill gaps in under 3 seconds using the Hugging Face Inference API.
